name: Pokémon Mansion & Secret Key
summary: Infiltrate the decrepit, fire-scarred halls of the Pokémon Mansion to uncover the dark origins of Mewtwo. Toggle secret switches on bronze statues across 1F, 2F, 3F, and B1F to unlock secure security shutters, grabbing TM22 Solar Beam and the vital Secret Key required to enter Blaine's Gym.

items.name: Secret Key
items.method: Floor pickup in the deepest subterranean laboratory room on B1F (Unlocks Cinnabar Gym)

items.name: TM22 Solar Beam
items.method: Floor pickup on B1F behind the northern switch-gated door

items.name: TM14 Blizzard
items.method: Floor pickup on 3F near the open balcony drop-off point

items.name: Max Potion
items.method: Floor pickup in the western debris room on 2F
